_doc: Text look of the later eras (docs/ERA_FEEL_TEXT.md), read by scripts/core/EraText.gd. eras: one row per era I-V. font: id of an own era font in scripts/ui/EraFontGlyphs.gd (built by tools/fonts/build_era_fonts.py), empty = the Chimora pixel font the era had before. portrait: none, icon (a 12 px head on the name plate) or bust (a 32 px animated portrait on the dialogue box). warp: a door warp variant that replaces the one of data/era_feel.json for this era, empty = keep it. languages: the languages the era fonts are drawn for; every other language keeps the pixel font and its CJK fonts. portrait: sizes and timings of the portraits (seconds). spiral: arms and turns of the spiral warp and how much longer it runs than the door wipe. speakers: id -> the names a speaker is shown under in the name tag; art is art/era5/portraits/<id>.png and art/era4/portraits/<id>.png (tools/art/gen_portraits.py). A speaker without an entry gets no portrait and the plain name tag.
